name: Kibbleton University
source:
Here you are, the new transfer to Kibbleton University (KU), and you just joined a brand-new club. Everything and everyone are new to you, but you might get this strange sense of familiarity about these people. Spend some time and build up an education in this new university, meet new students and faculty members on this journey of building your club up! 

[From [url=https://bokedaidu.itch.io/kibbleton-university]Itch.io[/url]]
